claims.label: Proposition 4 (only-if direction)
claims.gist: An alliance network is stable only if every alliance passes the effort test.
claims.statement: If an alliance network is stable, then every alliance in it satisfies the effort condition (E).

result.summary: A four-player stable network with an alliance that fails condition (E).
result.witness: A four-player network with two overlapping alliances is stable for the stated parameters, but one alliance fails (E).
result.tested: All networks with up to five players over a grid of cost parameters.
not_claimed: The if direction is not claimed to be false.
